scope: Offline separation of dispatch deadline vs USB transport completion; neutral-only diagnostic prepared; no device I/O
problem: The r2 candidate used one 4 ms bound for both the scheduling deadline and the overlapped WriteFile wait, so the first cold neutral packet aborted before any active frame.

separation.rule: Dispatch lateness and transport completion are classified independently; a slow completion is recorded, not treated as a scheduling miss.

files.writer_change: tools/switch_usb_output.py Writer.send(packet, timeout_ms=4) keeps the old default and the diagnostic passes 50.

diagnostic_guarantees: Every packet is report 0x10 with both channels 00 01 40 40; a non-neutral packet raises before send.
24 frames on the 4 ms grid, transport timeout 50 ms, 80 ms gap ceiling.
No configuration, initialization, feature or LED command.
Manual click with 6 s countdown; no automatic retry; timer resolution released in finally.
Does not touch Pico; does not claim haptic capability.
limits: Offline policy and packet checks only; real transport timing still unmeasured.
WriteFile completion is not controller ACK.
Neutral-only run cannot establish rumble support.
next: Run tools/switch_usb_timing_probe.py once with the controller in USB Switch mode and all outputs released; then decide the transport bound for the active pulse.
